# Sleepwalker

> A mythic science-fiction story of seven children, an impossible book and ruins on distant worlds that answer their dreams.

- [Sleepwalker](https://sleepwalker.in/index.md) ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/))

- [Blog](https://sleepwalker.in/blog/index.md): Standalone essays on cosmic scale and the craft of making a story. ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/blog/))

- [About Sleepwalker](https://sleepwalker.in/about/index.md): A mythic science-fiction graphic novel by Harsh Joshi, with an inquiry into its Vedic world and methods for making it. ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/about/))
